text:
tara: heads-up — multiple premerge SAST jobs started failing right after the KEK switch. lots of aborted runs, missing evidence. cc @oncall-sec

mohit: i rotated the kek and applied the new key policy at 05:41 UTC. i thought svc-scanner was included but i may have re-generated the binding without it. investigating.

elie: CI shows repeat: `rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = KMS.Decrypt denied` then scanner bails. sample from runner:
```
> pulling artifact bundle...
> kms: Decrypt failed: PermissionDenied
> scanner: exit 1
```

sec-bot: alert: scan-failure-rate jumped to 72% in 8m. auto-ticketing risk: high.

tara: mitigation: (1) grant a time-limited decrypt role to svc-scanner, (2) re-run affected matrices, (3) persist raw encrypted bundles to storage before decrypt, (4) tag vuln issues with `sdlc:keystore-retry`.

mohit: will add a 45m conditional binding now and paste audit id. planned command:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-inference/locations/global/keyRings/prod-kr/cryptoKeys/prod-llm-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter \
  --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-03-23T06:30:00Z"),title=tmp_scanner_decrypt'
```

mohit: posted audit id (redacted): KMS-AUDIT-77FF at 05:46 UTC. binding is live.

elie: add this small GH step so we never lose the raw bundle even if decrypt fails:
```
- name: Archive scanner bundle
  run: |
    tar -czf raw-bundle-${{ github.run_id }}.tgz scanner-output || true
    gsutil cp raw-bundle-${{ github.run_id }}.tgz gs://vuln-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/ || true
```

oncall-sec: muting scan noise alerts for 1h while re-runs proceed. monitoring backlog and SLOs. :white_check_mark:

tara: follow-ups: mohit remove the temp binding after re-runs (due in 1h), elie land the preserve step in pipeline (EOD), sec-bot ensure tickets include `sdlc:keystore-retry`. logging root cause candidate: KEK switch without re-applying scanner decrypt binding. we'll draft a short rotation checklist and smoke-run requirement. :memo:
